    CausalAudit.recordEvictionLimitExceeded(String topic, int partition, long offset, CausalDependencies gap)
    A CausalBufferLimit fired on a held record whose dependencies were not yet satisfied, and parsley.buffer.eviction.failure.policy = fail (the default) is configured: the record was not evicted — it remains buffered — and the owning Streams task is about to fail fast rather than deliver it out of causal order.
    void
    CausalAudit.recordHeld(String topic, int partition, long offset, int bufferDepth, CausalDependencies gap)
    A record's causal dependencies were not yet satisfied; it was admitted to the buffer to wait.
    void
    CausalAudit.recordViolation(String topic, int partition, long offset, CausalDependencies gap)
    A held record was evicted and forwarded out of causal order because a CausalBufferLimit fired before its dependencies were satisfied — a causal violation.
